dedupe_keys.name: historical fire weather data for fire program analysis raws and 32 km gridded

description: This service delivers historical fire weather data in the formats used by US wildland fire planning software such as FireFamily Plus and the Fire Program Analysis (FPA) system, which federal agencies use to plan firefighting resources. It is run by the Western Regional Climate Center at the Desert Research Institute. Two products are offered: historical records for Remote Automatic Weather Stations (RAWS), where gaps are filled with values estimated statistically from the North American Regional Reanalysis (NARR), delivered in fwx or fw9 format with a report of the share of missing or erroneous data and station metadata; and 32 km gridded data based on NARR across North America in fwx format. Requests are made online and results are posted to an FTP site with an email notice. Data are free; no licence is stated. Caveats: filled and gridded values are modelled, not observed, the formats need specific software versions, and the page now resolves to the WRCC archive site. Simulation uses: long weather series for fire danger rating and for sizing firefighting resources in emergency service models. Related records: the NIFC RAWS network (data-nifc-raws-remote-automatic-weather-stations) supplies the station observations, and the FPA fire occurrence database attributes (data-fpa-fod-attributes-us-wildfire-ignitions) give fire records for the same planning system.
